coordinates.model: X=E-615000; Y=elevation-70; Z=4827000-N; metres; glTF Y up

spatialSelection: Keep faces whose XZ bounding boxes intersect the actual district extent; border faces retain original positions, with no scaling or coordinate recentering.
integration: Import district context GLB plus district-details GLB. Preserve vertex colours/materials. Existing mode: StreetContext only. Construction mode: StreetContext and LRT. Future mode additionally enables SchematicVehicle, which is a dated illustrative LRV design, not an operating-service claim.
materials: Native per-vertex colours, not the generic terrain material. Each node has layerCategory and atlasStatus in glTF extras.
scope: Fifteen current interactive detail assets included beside this manifest. The working render variants are not claimed as files in this package.
